extracted.intended_audience: Researchers in the social sciences and humanities applying for SSHRC Insight Development Grants (individuals or teams)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and submitting an application for SSHRC Insight Development Grants to support short-term, early-stage research development in the social sciences and humanities. Covers eligibility, project purpose, funding limits, deadlines, and review process for this specific SSHRC program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program purpose / project stage
rubrics_metrics.description: Insight Development Grants support research in its initial stages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grants are intended for early-stage research and research development activities rather than for fully developed projects or long-term programmatic work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible project activities — development and experimentation
rubrics_metrics.description: The grants enable the development of new research questions, as well as experimentation with new methods, theoretical approaches and/or ideas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should clearly articulate how the proposed work will develop new questions or test/experiment with methods or theories; exploratory or pilot work is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project type and duration
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding is provided for short-term research development projects of up to two years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects must be planned as short-term research development activities; expected duration should not exceed two years. Different competitions list 1 to 2 year durations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding amount (value) limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Value and duration specified per competition (examples listed: $10,000 to $100,000 over 1 to 2 years for 2026; $7,000 to $75,000 over 1 to 2 years for 2024–2025).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must request an amount within the range announced for the applicable competition year. Check the specific competition details for the exact available range in that year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant eligibility — individuals or teams
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects may be proposed by individuals or teams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both sole applicants and multi-person teams are acceptable proposers; follow any additional eligibility details found in the Instructions/Applicants pages for the competition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competition timing and application deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Competitions have set application deadlines (example: February 2, 2026 (8:00 p.m. eastern)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications must be submitted by the announced deadline and time for the relevant competition year; consult the competition page for the precise deadline and time zone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review process — merit review committees
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are assessed by merit review committees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals will be peer-reviewed through SSHRC-appointed merit review committees; applicants should prepare materials suitable for committee assessment (see competition Instructions for review criteria and scoring details).

rubrics_metrics.name: Associated supplements and partner initiatives
rubrics_metrics.description: There are associated supplements and partner initiatives listed (examples: Belmont Forum; Department of National Defence Research Initiative; Mitacs Accelerate).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some competitions include or allow associated supplements or partnerships; applicants should review associated supplements information to determine eligibility for and requirements of these supplements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competition-specific documentation and instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Each competition year has linked pages for Competition details, Instructions, and Applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must follow the competition-specific Competition details and Instructions for that year (these contain the full application requirements, forms, and any additional eligibility or assessment criteria).
